_readme: Service posts pair one service with one audience (e.g. 'Meta ads for heating engineers'). Location posts pair a location with an audience and one of the locationAngles. Audiences with kind 'trade' are weighted first (the primary Meta ads target); 'local-business' audiences widen the net. webDesignPage links an audience to its /web-design/<slug> page for internal linking. excludePairs lists service:audience combinations that don't make sense.

services.name: Lead generation
services.summary: The full Integrate system: Meta ads shown to people in the client's area, an instant lead form, an AI WhatsApp agent that replies straight away and qualifies the lead (budget, location, job type, timing), then books qualified jobs into the business's calendar.

services.name: Meta ads
services.summary: Facebook and Instagram ads targeted at the client's service area, sending people to an instant lead form rather than a generic website, so enquiries arrive with the details needed to follow up.

services.name: AI WhatsApp lead qualification
services.summary: An AI agent on WhatsApp that messages every new lead within moments, asks about budget, location, job type and timing, filters out poor fits, and books qualified jobs straight into the calendar, so the business owner isn't chasing enquiries from a van or a roof.

services.name: AI website assistant
services.summary: A second AI agent on the business's own website that answers common questions, qualifies visitors the same way the WhatsApp agent does, and books them in, so website visits turn into enquiries outside working hours.

services.name: Websites
services.summary: Premium, fast, mobile-first websites built to win enquiries: clear services and areas covered, real photos, reviews, and obvious ways to get in touch. Integrate builds these as a standalone service and as part of the lead generation system.

services.name: AI automation
services.summary: Taking repetitive admin off the owner's plate with AI and automation: quote follow-ups, appointment reminders, review requests after a job, and passing information between the tools the business already uses.
